subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Analisar a estrutura de hipertexto e hiperlinks em textos de divulgação científica que circulam na Web e proceder à remissão a conceitos e relações por meio de links.

components.description_pt: Identificar estrutura de hipertexto e hiperlinks de textos de comunicação científica na Web
components.description_en: Identify the hypertext and hyperlink structure of science communication texts published on the Web
components.cc_component_description: Identify the organizational structure an author uses in a science or technical text

components.description_pt: Analisar como hiperlinks estabelecem relações entre conceitos em textos de comunicação científica digital
components.description_en: Analyze how hyperlinks establish relationships between concepts in digital science communication texts
components.cc_component_description: Distinguish explicit relationships between events, ideas, or concepts across texts

components.description_pt: Incorporar hiperlinks para conectar escrita a fontes de informação relevantes externas
components.description_en: Embed hyperlinks to connect writing to relevant outside information sources
components.cc_component_description: Embed hyperlinks to connect writing to relevant outside information sources

cc_matches.description: Use technology, including the Internet, to produce, publish, and update individual or shared writing products, taking advantage of technology's capacity to link to other information and to display information flexibly and dynamically.
Analyze the structure an author uses to organize a text, including how the major sections contribute to the whole and to an understanding of the topic.

Por medio de su repertorio lingüístico y utilizando artefactos multimodales, los estudiantes bi/multilingües podrán interpretar información para...
* identificar temas y/o entidades
* clasificar entidades según los detalles proporcionados
* navegar textos de manera coherente y cohesiva
* relacionar ideas, conocimientos y conceptos provenientes de diversas fuentes
* distinguir relaciones explícitas entre acontecimientos, ideas o conceptos en textos
* evaluar procedimientos o procesos
